properties.name: command
hand: prepare cancels a preview and drops the old subscriptions before a change
written subscribes to the new command, invalidates and hands it to the more gallery
properties.comment: The value command whose value the selection follows, which a click or Enter commits and which receives previews, or null. Without one the gallery keeps its own selection and offers no preview.

properties.name: item_size
hand: written rebuilds the model and hands the size to the more gallery
properties.comment: Every item's image area, in logical units at text scale 1. A size outside 16 to 256 on either side throws std::out_of_range.

properties.name: show_labels
hand: written rebuilds the model and hands the choice to the more gallery
properties.comment: Whether labels show under the images.

properties.name: visible_rows
properties.comment: In-ribbon form: the rows shown (1 to 8). A count outside that throws std::out_of_range.

properties.name: columns
hand: a view: set_column_range clamps the field directly
properties.comment: In-ribbon form: the current column count, kept inside the column range (owner decision RB-8: the ribbon's scaling gives up one column at a time within it). A count outside the range throws std::out_of_range.

properties.name: selected_id
properties.comment: The selected item's ID: the command's value, or the gallery's own selection; a write selects without committing (the command's set_value) and throws std::invalid_argument for an ID the gallery does not have. A view onto the command or the gallery's own selection.
hand: a view: the value has two owners (the bound command's value, else own_selection_); write_view and read_view keep the setter's and getter's bodies; owner 2026-11-08 (G14: selection is a cell)
